detailed_descriptions.en: Sushiamo is a Balatro-inspired roguelike deck-builder where you combine unique ingredients, tools, and sauces to create crazy sushi and trigger game-breaking combos. Find the synergy Every ingredient has a distinct bonus and synergy with other ingredients. Experiment to find the best combo! Build your perfect kitchen by collecting the right ingredients, tools and sauces to progress through increasingly higher scoring requirements and become a sushi master. Choose Your Path Navigate through a map that changes every run, where every choice matters, take the safer path or risk it all for greater rewards. Encounter unexpected events along the way that can grant you game-changing bonuses or set you back. So much content to unlock 🌊 Over 300+ items to discover 🎐 A market to discover your perfect setup 🍥 Unlockable ingredients, tools, sauces and more Credits: Trailer Music by " Won Jong Hwa "

Sushiamo is a Balatro-inspired roguelike deck-builder where you combine unique ingredients, tools, and sauces to create crazy sushi and trigger game-breaking combos.

Find the synergy

Every ingredient has a distinct bonus and synergy with other ingredients. Experiment to find the best combo!
Build your perfect kitchen by collecting the right ingredients, tools and sauces to progress through increasingly higher scoring requirements and become a sushi master.

Choose Your Path

Navigate through a map that changes every run, where every choice matters, take the safer path or risk it all for greater rewards.
Encounter unexpected events along the way that can grant you game-changing bonuses or set you back.
